jobs.description:

We are at the forefront of future engineering technologies, with solutions that ensure the success of our clients in key industries that are shaping the future of the world we live in.

We are looking for a Head of Division and Project Supply Chain Management (m/f/d) in Graz or Vienna. 1 Head of Division and Project Supply Chain Management (m/f/d) Your Tasks

 * Lead and further develop the Division and Project Supply Chain team with a clear focus on accountability, execution excellence, and performance ownership.

 * Establish and govern supplier performance frameworks, including quality, delivery reliability, and risk management across the supply base.

 * Implement international best practices in strategic sourcing, supplier quality governance, logistics excellence, and KPI-driven performance monitoring.

 * Benchmark supply chain performance against global standards to identify improvement opportunities and ensure operational excellence.

 * Shape a resilient supply chain setup, integrating sourcing, logistics strategies, and supplier development to respond effectively to global disruptions and market dynamics.

Your Profile

 * University degree in business, engineering, or equivalent.

 * Strong project experience in plant engineering (Anlagenbau) and complex capital projects.

 * Several years of experience in supply chain management, ideally in an international industrial environment.

 * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt beneficial.

 * Proven leadership experience and strong people management skills.

 * Expertise in demand planning, procurement, logistics, and end-to-end supplier performance and quality management.

 * Solid understanding of supplier quality governance, audit processes, and logistics concepts in project environments.

 * Strategic thinking and ability to align supply chain with business objectives.

 * Strong negotiation and contract management skills.

 * Excellent English skills; additional languages are an advantage.

 * Proficiency in SAP and common SCM tools.
